home.title: Upload a paper to automatically surface logical flaws
home.description: The system splits the paper into EDUs, extracts entities and relations, annotates RST/FRU structure, writes a Neo4j knowledge graph, then runs 13 REL rules to check it and list revision suggestions.

upload.dropHint: Drop a file here, or click to choose
upload.titlePlaceholder: Leave blank to auto-detect the title from the paper
upload.titleHelp: Usually no need to fill this in — the system reads the paper's title automatically; enter one manually to override.
upload.etaHint: Usually takes 1–10 minutes, depending on paper length
upload.bgHint: You can switch to another page or close the tab and do something else — the analysis finishes in the background and notifies you when done.
upload.cacheHitDesc: This file has already been analyzed; skipping reprocessing.

chat.title: Paper Assistant
chat.description: Can only discuss this paper's content and the detected defects. Replies cite [EDU:xxx] / [DEFECT:xxx].
chat.placeholder: Ask a question about this paper… (Enter to send / Shift+Enter for newline)
chat.rateLimited: Chatting too fast, please retry in {seconds} seconds
chat.eduJump: Click to jump to this passage
chat.suggestion1: What is this paper's core claim?
chat.suggestion2: Summarize the most severe defects found so far
chat.suggestion3: Are there any under-specified steps in the Method section?
